entities.name: Post-Invasion Democratic Restoration
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After the US withdrawal, Grenada restored democratic governance with elections in 1984 won by Herbert Blaize's New National Party. The country rebuilt its institutions and economy, with tourism and spice exports as the primary economic drivers.
